# YouPorn

> Free adult video streaming platform featuring HD porn videos, categories, channels, performer pages, and curated collections.

YouPorn organizes adult content through browseable video listings, category hubs, pornstar profiles, channels, playlists, and search-driven discovery. The site emphasizes free streaming, HD video browsing, and navigation by tags, performers, and content themes.

## Core Browse

- [Home](https://www.youporn.com/): Main landing page for featured, trending, and newly added adult videos.
- [Videos](https://www.youporn.com/videos/): Primary browse page for the full catalog of streaming videos.
- [Popular Videos](https://www.youporn.com/videos/popular/): Browse currently popular and widely viewed videos across the platform.
- [Newest Videos](https://www.youporn.com/videos/newest/): Recently added videos in reverse chronological order.
- [Top Rated Videos](https://www.youporn.com/videos/top_rated/): Highest rated videos based on user feedback and engagement.
- [Longest Videos](https://www.youporn.com/videos/longest/): Browse longer-form adult videos and extended scenes.
- [Most Viewed Videos](https://www.youporn.com/videos/most_viewed/): Videos ranked by total view count across the site.
